reading: Joined on role, a reading: Zid Agent (وكيل زد) powers AI-assisted features including product research, store optimization, campaign management and conversational assistance for the merchant (ZD-S-0717), the role of Shopify's Sidekick, an AI-enabled commerce assistant (SH-S-0736), and Salla's AI agent app (SA-S-3577). Strained: no Zid statement places the agent inside the admin; its one place is its own prepaid wallet (ZD-S-0713), and its features reach past an assistant into research and campaigns. All its statements are cited in this capability's tree (CM-AIA-001).

The same definition, a reading: سوق تطبيقات زد is a platform owned by Zid through which the merchant links the store to one of the apps it offers (ZD-S-0861), lists public apps for all merchants to view and install (ZD-S-0862), and publishes an app after Zid's team reviews and tests it (ZD-S-0863); Salla's app marketplace (SA-S-0002) and review (SA-S-0023), Shopify's App Store (SH-S-2753) and review (SH-S-0698). Its statements are cited in CM-APP-001, CM-APP-002 and CM-APP-004, one tree. Strained: two inventory entries Q1 placed in it are cited in other trees, its app categories for AI (ZD-I-0430, ZD-I-0431) in CM-AIA-001, as apps doing AI work, and the App Partner terms (ZD-I-0426, placed also in ZD-C-022) in CM-PTN-001.

Joined by the terms Authorization and OAuth: Zid's Base OAuth Server URL for app authentication (ZD-S-0869) and its Authorization header (ZD-S-0875); Salla's Authorization page and OAuth 2.0 (SA-S-1013, SA-S-0176); Shopify's API authentication (SH-I-0030). Scopes are cited in CM-API-003 and the header in CM-API-001, the same tree. Strained: its webhook topic app.market.application.authorized (ZD-S-0073) is cited in CM-APP-004, in the APP tree, where the app's other lifecycle events are.

Joined by the term Webhooks: Zid's API group Webhooks > APIs (ZD-S-0044) and its endpoint POST /v1/managers/webhooks (ZD-S-0882); Salla's Merchant API folder Webhooks (SA-S-1068); Shopify's API docs entry Webhooks (SH-S-0791). Its conditions (ZD-S-0880) are cited in the child CM-API-010. Its health tracking (circuit breaker, broken state) stays here: one endpoint, Health Summary, in the Webhooks group, isn't a place of its own (notes).

Joined by the terms embedded and iframe: Zid's Embedded Apps, integrated into the dashboard through an iframe (ZD-S-0884) and opening inside the Zid Merchant Dashboard (ZD-S-0885); Salla's third-party application in an iframe through the Embedded SDK (SA-S-0197); Shopify's App Home (iframe) (SH-I-0054). Its authentication mechanism and scope are cited in the parent CM-APP-006, one tree.

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's private apps, intended for specific stores only, not listed in the Zid App Market and installed only by stores granted access (ZD-S-0893), and its plan line Connect your store with external systems (via API) (ZD-S-0387), are the role of Shopify's custom distribution for a specific merchant (SH-S-0693) and its plan line Build custom apps using Shopify APIs (SH-S-7054). Strained: Zid's private app may be a partner's, installed by stores it grants access, where Shopify's custom app is one the store develops or has developed; and the concern's statement that Zid provides the APIs and connection tools (ZD-S-0892) is cited in CM-API-001, in the API tree.

The same definition, a reading: any required app-plan payment is completed through Zid (ZD-S-0684), and standard apps keep their charges within Zid's plans with no partner-side payment (ZD-S-0685); a paid app's payment goes through the Salla platform (SA-S-0025); Shopify collects the charge and pays out the developer's share (SH-S-0282). Strained: the concern also holds the partner's payouts (Payments → Payouts, partner rate, withholding tax), cited in CM-PTN-003, in the PTN tree; and its subscription events are cited in CM-APP-004, the same tree as here.

Joined on role, a reading: زد نمو (Zid Growth), reached at Dashboard > Growth (ZD-S-1078), lists services that partners provide, which the merchant adds to a cart and subscribes to (ZD-S-1080): the role of Salla's Merchant Services (SA-S-1885), whose service providers are partners serving merchants (SA-S-0198), and of Shopify's Partner Directory (SH-S-0760). Strained: its staff permissions name services beyond a partner's expertise, such as packaging, self-storage units and co-working spaces (ZD-I-0487, ZD-I-0525, ZD-I-0534), and a relationship manager on the Professional plan (ZD-S-1079) whose provider isn't stated; Q1 notes the provider of each service as needing observation.
